correctness.rationale: Generic plane inverse maps apex to planar q=(-hu_x/u_z,-hu_y/u_z) and projects base to rectangle [-a,a]x[-b,b]. Exactly one exceeded rectangular coordinate yields a five-vertex hull, giving disjoint Cauchy strip events. Isotropic planar Cauchy density h/[2pi(h²+x²+y²)^{3/2}] integrates to p=(2/pi)[atan(a/h)+atan(b/h)-2 asin(ab/sqrt((a²+h²)(b²+h²)))]. Direct derivative sign equals F(t)-(a+b) for t=h² with F(t)=2ab(2t+a²+b²)/[(t+ab)sqrt(t+a²+b²)]; F decreases strictly from 2sqrt(a²+b²)>a+b to 0. Fixed-area derivative in shape s=(a²+b²)/(ab) is strictly positive. In thin base r->inf unique t*/r->1 yields 1-p~4/(pi sqrt r). Independent randomized 3D projected-hull calculations matched formula on multiple asymmetric examples; analytic derivatives are proof.
